description: Implementation of the AudioFrameTracker class, managing audio frame counts and playback rate adjustments within the starboard::shared::starboard::player::filter namespace.

classes.name: AudioFrameTracker
classes.description: Tracks audio frames and playback rates, providing methods to add, record, and query future frames adjusted to playback rate.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal frame records and playback adjustment counter.

methods.name: AddFrames
methods.description: Adds a number of frames with a specified playback rate to the tracker.

methods.name: RecordPlayedFrames
methods.description: Records the number of frames that have been played, adjusting internal counters accordingly.

methods.name: GetFutureFramesPlayedAdjustedToPlaybackRate
methods.description: Calculates the total number of frames that will be played in the future, adjusted to playback rate, for a given number of frames.
